scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: APDMem: Agent-Controlled Progressive Disclosure for Query-Adaptive Long-Term Memory
papers.authors: Chin-Lun Fu, Anagha Kulkarni, Hong Ni, Behrouz Madahian
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02472v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Personalized LLM assistants must recover sparse evidence from long conversation histories across queries of varying complexity. We introduce APDMem (Agent-controlled Progressive Disclosure Memory), a hierarchical long-term memory architecture that applies progressive disclosure to memory retrieval. Rather than relying on a flat memory store or fixed retrieval granularity, APDMem represents conversation history as four progressively detailed layers: thematic summaries, personalized key facts, turn-level evidence notes, and raw messages. At inference time, a controller applies progressive disclosure to the memory hierarchy: it first reads high-level summaries and drills into finer evidence only when needed. This creates an adaptive cost-fidelity trade-off: simple queries can terminate early, while complex temporal, multi-hop, or exact-evidence queries trigger deeper inspection. A note synthesizer converts retrieved evidence into a query-fo
papers.summary: APDMem 将长期对话组织为主题摘要、个人事实、轮次证据和原始消息四层，由控制器按查询需求逐层展开，并合成带时间与冲突信息的回答依据。在 500 题 LongMemEval-S 上，GPT-4.1 配置准确率达 87.8%，对照 SimpleMem 为 84.0%，平均只深入读取 8% 的会话；这并不代表完整推理成本同步降低 92%。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索可借鉴“先定位主题，再展开原帖”的证据导航，复杂时间与多跳问题才读取细粒度内容。应把证据充分性、矛盾检查和停止条件做成显式工具状态，并分别监测 nDCG、最终回答正确率与端到端延迟；文中冷启动控制器平均需 37.7 秒，尚不能直接视为实时搜索方案。

papers.title: CUEing User Simulators: Calibrated User Embeddings for Multi-Turn Benchmarking
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02460v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent benchmarks rely on user simulators to evaluate AI agents in multi-turn interaction. While existing simulation techniques demonstrate surface fidelity to human style and behavior, ecologically valid interactive benchmarking also requires alignment in when and how agents fail across simulated and real user populations. We find that existing simulators lack outcome calibration: agreement with observed success rates and failure patterns when real users interact with the same agent. We introduce Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE), a framework that both encodes observed sessions and samples continuous representations, then decodes them into persona commands to steer LLMs to act as user simulators without training. Through this, we evaluate user-conditioned replay of past sessions and aggregate metric agreement when sampling novel personas for the same tasks. On $\tau^2$-Bench, CUEd simulators commit fewer simulator-attributed errors and m
papers.summary: CUE 用连续用户表征编码真实交互，再解码成人设指令来驱动用户模拟器，重点校准代理何时失败，而不只模拟说话风格。在 τ²-Bench 的 Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite 配置中，CUE 的成功率偏差为 0.12，对照 RealUserSim 为 0.32；失效模式宏 F1 为 0.62，对照为 0.46，表明不同模拟器会改变评测结论。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的多轮追问和复杂需求评测，可以用真实失败会话校准模拟用户，再检验新代理是否修复同类错误。应同时报告总体成功率偏差、任务用户对的一致性以及失败模式，而不能用对话自然度代替有效性。论文也发现部分模型下无模拟人设的基线更接近真人成功率，迁移到 UGC 场景前必须重新校准。

papers.title: Beyond Correctness: Resolving Underspecification in Agentic Text-to-SQL
papers.authors: Wen-Zhi Li, Yue Gong, Konstantinos Kanellis, Balakrishnan Murali Narayanaswamy
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02739v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic Text-to-SQL systems can interact with users to clarify underspecified queries before generating SQL. However, a correct execution result does not necessarily imply that the agent has adequately resolved the underlying underspecification: the agent may silently make unverified assumptions that happen to match the intended answer. We show that this behavior is driven in part by premature clarification termination. Although forcing an agent to ask more questions improves execution accuracy, ambiguities are concentrated in earlier interactions, making brute-force questioning inefficient. More importantly, even when explicitly prompted to plan its clarification process, the agent frequently abandons questions that it has already identified as relevant. To address this failure mode, we introduce PlanPool, which externalizes the clarification plan as a mutable question pool. Every planned question must be explicitly asked or dropped bef
papers.summary: PlanPool 针对交互式 Text-to-SQL 过早停止澄清的问题，把待解决歧义外置为可增删的问题池，提交前要求逐项询问或明确放弃。在 BIRD-Lite 上，歧义召回从朴素代理的 73.9% 升至 87.5%，执行准确率从 74.3% 升至 81.3%，静默失败从 17.0% 降至 8.2%，代价是平均提问由 2.3 次增至 4.2 次。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索中的“附近”“最好”“最近”等意图不能仅靠最终答案碰巧正确来评估。可将地域、时间、对象和排序标准维护成待确认状态，允许代理随着证据更新问题池，并对默认假设保留依据。应同时衡量意图覆盖和用户交互成本；BIRD-Full 上 PlanPool 的执行准确率并非最高，不能宣称全面胜出。

papers.title: When History Fails to Become Experience: Action Calibration in Language Agents
papers.authors: Jingyu Liu, Zhiwen Wang, Yuxin Jing, Huanyu Zhou, Yong Liu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02769v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Language agents should draw on prior attempts and environmental feedback to improve subsequent decisions within the same task. However, providing additional interaction history can sometimes reduce task success, suggesting that agents do not consistently use this information effectively. To investigate this limitation, we examine how agents use history. We find that history improves task completion overall, yet much of this benefit persists even when past actions are shuffled. Disrupting the correspondence between actions and observations causes only a modest decline in task success. We therefore hypothesize that agents do not reliably connect past actions with their outcomes when deciding how to proceed. To test this hypothesis, we explicitly label each returned observation as the outcome of the preceding action. This simple annotation improves task success and reduces next-action repetition without introducing new environmental informa
papers.summary: 研究发现代理虽利用历史信息，却不可靠地关联动作与反馈；作者给返回观察标注前一动作的结果，并进一步学习选择性经验校准器。在五种模型、四个环境的历史干预实验中，每种条件包含 10,000 次运行；固定 1,815 条失败历史上，下一步动作重复率由 36.91% 降至因果标注的 32.23%，经验校准后为 21.38%。
papers.key_insight: 在社区搜索代理反复改写同一查询、打开同一帖子时，可先把“查询、召回结果、失败原因”组织成动作与结果对，再考虑训练校准器。保留近期反馈与可验证经验，比机械扩大上下文更值得试验。上述重复率来自固定历史诊断，不等于线上 CTR 提升；业务验证还需跟踪有效新证据率、请求次数和最终任务成功率。

papers.title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
papers.abstract: Abstract: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects. Additional editing improves average automatic readability preference across two benchmarks, with different trends on each.
papers.authors: Meituan LongCat Team, Zhu, He, Xu, Yue, Wu, Wanli, Ren, Haolin, Bian, Yuxin, Zhao, Jiarui, Zhang, Rongzhi, Weng, Quanchi, Cui, Jinghao, Fan, Yu, Liu, Yuhan, Ye, Yunhu, Ren, Jiyuan, Yuan, Fengcheng, Yang, Zhao, Zhang, Jiacheng, Dai, Yuchuan, Xiao, Ruixuan, Sun, Haozhe, Liu, Xiangyuan, Sun, Cheng, Du, Yao, Hao, Yiming, Guo, Hongbo, He, Shuo, Wang, Lei, Cai, Xunliang, Chen, Yan, Yang, Fan, Liu, Lingchuan
papers.summary: LongCat-DeepResearch 将规划、分节调查和局部修订分离：规划代理形成 ResearchSpec，研究代理在独立上下文内获取证据并写作，再依据全局审查修改相关章节。系统在 DeepResearchBench、DeepResearchBench II、ResearchRubrics 分别得分 55.25、51.35、79.83，内部基准为 76.04；开发集显示继续细化规划并非总能改善结果。
papers.key_insight: 针对社区中需要整合多篇帖子与评论的复杂问题，可先产出带证据需求的研究规格，再按子问题整理材料并局部修订答案。工程上应明确全局意图、章节证据和最终审查的边界，减少反复重写带来的事实漂移。这些是研究报告指标，不是 nDCG 或 CTR；线上应限制调用预算，并用来源覆盖、冲突率和延迟验证收益。

papers.title: Mr.LHDR: A Benchmark for Multimodal Real-World Long-Horizon Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract: Deep research agents are increasingly capable of web search, tool use, multimodal evidence analysis, and information synthesis. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate medium-horizon exploration and rarely test whether agents can sustain long, dependency-heavy research processes. We introduce Mr. LHDR (Multimodal real-world Long-Horizon Deep Research), a benchmark for evaluating real-world deep research over long, irreducible chains of interdependent evidence across eight categories. Each question is constructed from a hidden Node-Relation graph and requires an average of 12.1 necessary intermediate conclusions with a mean dependency depth of 10.4 before reaching a short, unique, and verifiable answer. Questions incorporate multimodal evidence, including images, maps, PDFs, logos, charts, tables, and video frames, with at least one non-text element that changes the reasoning state. Mr. LHDR evaluates both final answers and the correctness of intermediate conclusions under annotated dependencies. We evaluate general models, deep research systems, and agent frameworks using Overall Accuracy (OA), Strict Accuracy (SA), Checklist Score (CS), and Dependency-Aware Checklist Score (DACS). Results show that even the strongest system achieves only 43.1% OA and 34.3% SA, indicating that final-answer accuracy substantially overestimates complete research success. Removing images reduces DACS by 12.6 points, demonstrating the importance of multimodal evidence, while SA consistently declines as reasoning chains become longer. These findings reveal sustained, dependency-consistent evidence integration, rather than isolated fact retrieval, as a key bottleneck for current deep research agents.
papers.authors: Guo, Minghao, Cao, Meng, Zhao, Sui, Ning, Siyu, Wang, Xin, Zhao, Haoze, Yang, Jiaxuan, Hao, Haihong, Han, Mingfei, Rong, Shunlin, Wu, Haijun, Liang, Xiaodan, Chang, Xiaojun
papers.summary: Mr.LHDR 测试长程多模态研究代理能否保持依赖链一致，每题平均需要 12.1 个中间结论，平均依赖深度 10.4，覆盖八类任务并含会改变推理状态的非文本证据。最强系统最终答案准确率为 43.1%，严格成功率只有 34.3%；移除图片使依赖感知检查表得分下降 12.6 个百分点，暴露仅看最终答案的高估。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索涉及截图、地图、表格或视频时，代理需要证明中间结论之间的依赖关系。可用隐藏证据图设计回归任务，同时评分最终答案、逐条结论和依赖一致性，避免最后猜中答案掩盖过程缺证。该基准偏长程深度研究，应把方法迁移到真实 UGC 任务，而不直接把其准确率当作日常检索服务的能力估计。

papers.title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
papers.authors: Omar Farouk Zouak, Houssam Eddine Boukhalfa, Soumaya Lakehal, Shiv Katiyar, Samia Nefti-Meziani
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02444v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models often solve a theorem forward yet fail to disprove a closely related false one: a falsification gap that supervised fine-tuning does not close and can actively worsen. We frame counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against a deterministic per-theorem Python verifier, and release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with executable verifiers. The verifier also serves as the reward function, making SymCE a training environment. Training Qwen3-4B with SFT followed by GRPO under this oracle reveals an imitation trap: counterexample-only SFT collapses true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR with a sparse outcome-only reward repairs this and exceeds the base, to 0.66. The collapse replicates across four seeds and on Gemma-3-4B. Sparse and dense rewards yield statistically indistinguishable in-domain success yet diverge by 33 poin
papers.summary: SymCE 将反例生成转为确定性 Python 验证器可判定的见证输出，构建 4,707 条错误猜想并用验证器提供强化学习奖励。Qwen3-4B 的纯反例监督微调把真定理识别率从 0.27 降至 0.00，稀疏结果奖励训练后四种随机种子的平均值回升至 0.66；177 项人工审计显示验证器判断准确率为 97.7%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索代理训练，值得借鉴的是可执行验证与奖励分布审计，而非数学任务的结果本身。只训练“必须找到支持证据”的轨迹也可能诱导无依据的回答，应加入无答案、反证和停止检索的对照。论文中稀疏与稠密奖励域内表现相近，但校准探针相差约 33 个百分点，提示单一成功率不足以判断策略可靠性。

papers.title: Asterism: Exploring and Synthesizing Scattered Observations into Literature-Grounded Hypotheses and Theories
papers.authors: Joseph Chee Chang, Michael D'Arcy, Amy X. Zhang, Pao Siangliulue, Sangho Suh, Aakanksha Naik, Jena D. Hwang, Javier Ramos Benitez, Stella Wroblewski, Matt Latzke, Michael Cuoco, Ruben Lozano-Aguilera, Kris Ganjam, Joel Chan, Doug Downey, Peter Jansen, Kyle J. Travaglini, Daniel S. Weld
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02673v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: A theory draws many independent observations into one framework with novel hypotheses. A researcher building such a theory must synthesize observations scattered across many papers, each describing related concepts but often in different terms. Which concepts matter most also depends on their preferences and research questions. Recent approaches scale theory synthesis with LLMs, but automate away choices and intuitions from researchers. We present Asterism, which extracts observations from hundreds of papers as concept-relation triples, with concepts unified in a hierarchical ontology. Researchers curate an evidence graph using the ontology and aggregate observations at different levels of granularity to focus theory formation on specific phenomena of interest. In a field deployment (n=10), researchers worked from observations to theories, and kept concepts and hypotheses fitting their preferences. In two case studies, teams of immunol
papers.summary: Asterism 从数百篇论文抽取概念关系三元组，用层级本体合并不同表述，再让研究者通过证据图选择概念并生成有来源的假设。论文报告 10 名研究者的实地部署和免疫学、农业两个案例；示例界面汇总约 100 篇论文，并为节点和关系标注支持论文数。结果属于探索性用户研究，未报告搜索 nDCG 或线上 CTR。
papers.key_insight: 复杂 UGC 搜索可把散落帖子的观点归纳为有原文链接的证据关系，并让用户决定研究方向，避免代理自动替用户选定结论。优先借鉴来源计数、层级概念展开和假设到证据的可追溯链路。文献领域的本体构建成本与 10 人研究规模限制了外推，社区短文本仍需独立检验关系抽取误差和观点冲突处理。

papers.title: Finding the Move Is Not Winning the Game: XiangqiBench for Closed-Loop Evaluation of LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yekun Chai, Qiwei Peng, Haoyi Xiong
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02425v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Static evaluations credit a language model for naming the right move, but an agent must carry a plan through to a verified outcome while an opponent responds. We introduce XiangqiBench, an executable benchmark that measures this difference in Chinese chess: starting from 119 tactical endgames with forced mates supported by engine or checks-only search, an LLM agent must deliver checkmate against an engine defender. An interactive REPL interface separates real moves, state queries, and forward simulation, and we record 8,568 multi-turn trajectories from 12 frontier LLMs under two observation protocols. Three signals that look like competence each overstate closed-loop success. (i) The Conversion Gap: models play the stored reference first move in 26.1\% of Sighted trials, yet only 13.9\% of these trials end in a win. (ii) The Consistency Gap: the leading model reaches 38.7\% pass@3 but only 5.9\% pass^3, winning all three trials on 7 of t
papers.summary: XiangqiBench 用 119 个强制将杀残局和可执行 REPL 检查代理能否把正确首步转成完整胜局，收集 12 个前沿模型的 8,568 条多轮轨迹。Sighted 设置中，参考首步匹配率为 26.1%，匹配首步的运行里只有 13.9% 最终获胜；领先模型至少一次成功的 pass@3 为 38.7%，三次全成功的可靠性仅 5.9%。
papers.key_insight: 搜索代理也可能先找对关键网页，却在后续阅读、交叉验证和回答阶段失败。评测应区分证据命中、完整任务成功和重复运行可靠性，并把只读观察、模拟计划与真实工具执行分开记录。象棋的确定性环境与社区检索不同，数字不能直接迁移；可借鉴闭环任务验收方式，用最终有来源答案验证搜索链条是否真正完成。

papers.title: Open and Emergent Problems in Agentic Privacy and Security: A Contextual Angle
papers.summary: Google 分享 CAPS 工作坊的研究报告，由超过 50 位学术与工业参与者共同梳理自主代理的隐私与安全问题。文章从非结构化输入、概率执行路径和自治委托三个差异出发，提出上下文策略引擎及系统、模型、用户、多代理、治理五类防护方向；这是架构与问题讨论，未给出实验基准成绩或线上效果数字。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索代理可能读取私密历史、调用外部检索并组合用户身份信息，权限应结合发送者、接收者、信息类别和传输规则决定。可把查询相关的隐私约束落实为工具调用前的策略检查，并在任务变化时更新访问范围。本文提供设计框架而非已验证产品收益，实践需要用越权、提示注入和跨用户泄漏测试检验策略有效性。
